name: BACH_0258_FSIM_resample3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (69%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Unreliable resampled frozen section [F6] cannot exclude Benign [F1]; recut, deeper levels, and margin deferral drafted [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 69%, Benign 15%, Invasive 13%, Normal 2% | InSitu leads; 13% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% target; 90% test coverage) | Cannot separate InSitu from Benign |
| Reliability / OOD | 30% reliability (flagged); 100% OOD | Suspect out-of-distribution resampled input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False (disagree) | Backbones disagree on top class |
| Similar cases | 3/5 (60%) InSitu, 1 Invasive, 1 Benign [F5] | Mixed neighbors; weak case consensus |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Scarce infiltration (-0.17, contrib -0.68) pushes against invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable (0/20 spot check); scarce lobules (-0.06, contrib +0.58) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 7, 10) · context · Above-typical TILs (+1.12, contrib -0.54); descriptive context only [F4] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Below-average benign stroma (-0.29 SD, contrib +0.27); contrast feature · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.0114; CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven classifier faithfulness (CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable normal_lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20), mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Resampled frozen-section degradation (30% reliability, 100% OOD) mimics in situ atypia in a benign lesion.
- High-risk regions 5 (97%) and 6 (64%) harbor stromal invasion like Invasive neighbor BACH_0303 (73% similarity).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 6, 1**: Highest heatmap invasive risk (97%, 64%, 41%); verify duct confinement versus stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 3, 7, 10, 11**: Inspect stroma (3, 11) and TILs (7, 10) against Invasive neighbor BACH_0303.
3. **Regions 0, 3**: Check benign tubules (0); defer lateral/superior margins (100%, 99% in 3) to permanents.
